errors.evidence: The label in the legend is "Силно съгласен", not "Сильно съгласен". "Сильно" is a Russian word, while "Силно" is the correct Bulgarian word used in the figure.
For the orange line ("2 По-скоро съгласен"), the value for the 26-34 age group is 26%, not 20%. Consequently, the line increases slightly from 25% to 26%, it does not decrease.
For the yellow line ("4 По-скоро несъгласен"), the value for the 26-34 age group is 20%, not 26%. Consequently, the line decreases from 22% to 20%, it does not increase.

errors.evidence: The dark blue line does not start at 12%. The value 12% corresponds to the 35-44 age group. The starting value at 19-25 is an unlabeled point, which is visually much lower, around 2-4%.

The description of the trend for the dark blue line is incorrect. The line starts at a very low value (unlabeled) for the 19-25 group, then goes to 2% for the 26-34 group. This is not a sharp drop ("рязко спада").
